## The case

Who hits this, and what are they doing when they hit it. The situation, not the
solution.

## What they do today

The workaround, or the manual step, and what it costs them.

## What done would look like

The observable outcome, described so it can be measured. Not the implementation.

## Why now

What makes this worth doing rather than later.
